title: Holotape
content:
Type: NOTE
Papyrus: Holotape Script, ObjectReference Script The Holotape can playback a Sound Descriptor, voice, display a Terminal, or execute a flash program. The holotape object is found within the Object Window under the Items Category. Editor Dialog: File:Holotape Editor.png - - - - - - - - Type: Select a data type to display. Sound: The Sound Descriptor to play. Voice: The Quest scene dialogue to start. These flash files are executed as applications. Terminal: The Terminal to display. - Pickup/Putdown Sounds * Notes: None See Also: - Items Category
